findings.title: Exhausting federated recovery codes calls removeStoredCredentialById instead of disabling in user storage and can fail on null ID
findings.body: When recovery codes come from a federated `UserStorageProvider` via `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(authenticatedUser)`, exhausting the last recovery code (`recoveryCodeCredentialModel.allCodesUsed()`) still calls `authenticatedUser.credentialManager().removeStoredCredentialById(recoveryCodeCredentialModel.getId())`. `removeStoredCredentialById` only deletes from local or `UserFederatedStorage` credential stores and does not remove/disable the credential in the `UserStorageProvider` (which is done via `disableCredentialType`). Furthermore, if the provider constructs the model with `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues(...)` without setting an ID (as `BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials` does), `getId()` is `null`, causing `EntityManager.find(..., null)` in the JPA credential store to throw an `IllegalArgumentException`.

findings.title: Missing null check for myUser and missing credential ID in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials
findings.body: `getCredentials(RealmModel realm, UserModel user)` dereferences `myUser.recoveryCodes` and `myUser.otp` without checking `if (myUser == null)` (unlike `getDisableableCredentialTypesStream`, `isConfiguredFor`, and `isValid` in the same class). Because `UserCredentialManager.getFederatedCredentialsStream()` calls `getCredentials` on all enabled `CredentialInputValidator` providers in the realm when resolving credentials for a local user, calling `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(user)` for any user not present in `BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage` will throw a `NullPointerException` before the fallback to local stored credentials can run. Additionally, `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues(...)` on line 237 does not copy the ID set on `myUser.recoveryCodes` in `updateCredential` (`model.setId(myUser.recoveryCodes.getId())`), leaving the returned credential's ID as `null`.
